controls: Overcapacity, duplicated family and invalid window mutations rejected.
Indexed acceptance compared with direct literal predicates on deterministic registered bounded role samples.
Any selected witness receives fresh complete fill/profile reconstruction, exact mass conservation, nonincreasing positive idle-child count and maxrank48.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.counts: Per-shard disjoint source coverage. Complete reduction requires84unique shards,666calls,271728source roles perseed and exact disjoint categories summing to36862620480: equal-width, same-bin unequal, capacity/nonpositive spread, window rejection, family rejection, strict improvement. Report every analytic exclusion.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.direct_control_domain: For each seed,128pairs drawn by that seed from the full distinct-call domain plus every selected witness; compare indexed membership and direct exact guards, with no solver.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.enumeration: Orient unequal widths by a>b. Canonical role index408*call+helper. Exhaust all higher-width sources; exact bit intersections count all lower-width targets without sampling. Eight consecutive source calls per shard:84shards per seed. Seed changes source traversal order only.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.exact_predicate: For d=a-b>0, original residuals rA,rB and capacities capA,capB, require different physical bins,0<=rA+d<=capA,0<=rB-d<=capB,d*(rA-rB+d)>0. Equivalent range d<=rB<rA+d. Both target windows must contain the incoming call. Both simultaneous remove/add family sets must remain injective. Same-family exchanges use the exact exception and are not silently omitted.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.family_guard: For different families, fB is absent from callA except removed fA and fA absent from callB except removed fB. Same-family swaps must pass the literal simultaneous family test. Exact physical assignment includes port.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.incomplete: Any missing shard, coverage discrepancy, failed control, error or cutoff prevents a scientific PASS/NULL. TIMEOUT/ERROR/EXPLORATORY do not reset lane streak.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.null_bar: Entire registered domain completes with no feasible strict improvement and all controls pass. NULL is limited to two-role cross-call exchanges on this literal fill.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.pass_bar: Entire census completes, all controls pass, selected concrete improving witness passes complete literal/profile checks and exact concavity proof; both seeds select identical candidate bytes. This is constructive fill PASS only; V1 complete changed-obligation admission is mandatory for the user goal.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.question: Can an exact cross-call exchange of two unequal-width roles improve the latest pinned complete profile?
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.recording: Immutable RESULT.json perseed, per-shard compressed checkpoints, exact counts, candidate FILL/PROFILE and hashes, source archive, memory projection, measured CPU/wall/RSS, complete source attribution.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.scope: All unordered roles from distinct calls: choose(666,2)*408^2 = 36862620480. Same-call pairs are excluded and separately reported. Equal-width exchanges are analytically nonimproving.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.second_seed: Repeat the complete exact indexed census with independent source traversal; canonical candidate bytes and verdict must agree.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.selection: Maximum integer squared residual gain2*d*(rA-rB+d), then lexicographically smallest sorted pair((call,helper),(call,helper)); no numerical root-based selection.
C3-CROSS-CALL-EXCHANGE.stop_rule: C2 is the immediately preceding scientific NULL in this lane. A confirmed C3 NULL is the second consecutive NULL and stops the constructive-fill lane for this round.
